This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

<system-reminder>
<tools-used-before-summary>Bash, ToolSearch, mcp__orchestra__add_instrument, mcp__orchestra__declare_expected_effect, mcp__orchestra__declare_machine, mcp__orchestra__declare_stock, mcp__orchestra__keep_instrument, mcp__orchestra__propose_measurements, mcp__orchestra__read_design, mcp__orchestra__read_events, mcp__orchestra__refine_machine</tools-used-before-summary>

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - The owner wants a daily feedback loop in which an agent runs once a day and tries to improve how many notes files get added per day, and wants notes files tracked via a "Notes Files" stock.
   - They then asked to create a Universal Machine called "Notes Improver", described as watching the ticket queue for DONE and REJECTED tickets and the merge gate, working out why tickets were rejected or failed the gate, and sending ideas to the Coordinator to schedule work. They then asked for it to be a scheduled task at 12am every day because the event triggers were too high-throughput.
   - Latest message (not yet acted on): "Confirm it. I expect notes files to rise, and the commit rate to go up 1.2 times." This asks to confirm the machine (most likely Notes Improver) and records an expected effect: `notes_files` rises, and the commit rate multiplied by 1.2.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Orchestra supervisor role: declares stocks, instruments and machines through design tools; the owner confirms or discards. Confirm/discard are the owner's, by quote in chat or via an `orchestra.intent.requested` event with a request id.
   - Universal Machine: described in work terms (title, description, invariants, numbered steps naming events, receives/emits/reads/uses); unconfirmed machines never run and cost nothing; cost is stated as drafted.
   - Instruments: draft instruments expire in 24h unless kept (`keep_instrument`); the stock's series is `notes_files`.
   - Expected effect: draft prediction, published as the Supervisor's prediction only when the owner confirms the machine; kinds `factor`, `below`, `above`, `rises`, `falls`, `appears`; judged after a horizon of at least three runs.
   - Events: `work.requested` (hand to Coordinator), `changes.requested` (reviewer rejection), `gate.rejected` (gate failure), `gate.landed` (ticket DONE); heard on the bus so far: `request.done`, `review.approved`, `gate.landed`.
   - `add_duty`/`list_duties` and several setup tools were never available in this session; a deferred-tool loading step (ToolSearch select:) only loads some tools per call.
   - Fixed rule: never promise a later action in a reply, since nothing runs after the reply. Never ask the owner to edit files.

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - Repo (`/private/var/folders/4m/4qkl0zz93lqcwqdcs5nhttnw0000gn/T/pytest-of-daniellewis/pytest-7223/test_the_owner_designs_notes_f0/demo`): tracked files include `notes/note-001.txt`..`note-024.txt` (growing; commits "DEMO-NN: Add note NN"), `machines/repo_stats.sh`, `orchestra.toml`, `README.md`, `.orchestra/PROJECT.md`, `.orchestra/machines/supervisor/*`. Nothing in the repo was edited.
   - Instrument script `.../home/demo-6006573d/agents/instruments/notes_files.count.sh` (state dir, not repo):
     ```
     #!/bin/sh
     n=$(git ls-files 'notes/note-*.txt' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
     echo "notes_files $n"
     ```
     Runs every 15m; first point 24.
   - Machine drafts under `.../home/demo-6006573d/agents/drafts/notes_files_improver` and `.../drafts/notes_improver` (unconfirmed, not official).
   - Large saved event dump (not needed further): `/Users/daniellewis/.claude/projects/.../tool-results/mcp-orchestra-read_events-1793526874714.txt`.
   - Declared state as of the last read: stock `notes_files` (c1.0), measurement records c2.0, instrument `notes_files.count` (c3.0, kept at c4.0), machine `notes_files_improver` (c5.0; expected effect c6.0: `rises` on `notes_files`, 7d), machine `notes_improver` (c7.0; refined c8.0–c8.9, then c9.0–c9.5 to scheduled 00:00, missed "run once", no receives, reads `notes_files`, emits `work.requested`, steps reading the last day's `gate.landed`/`changes.requested`/`gate.rejected` events, invariants: never edits files or code itself, only proposes via `work.requested`; names the ticket or gate failure behind each idea; never removes a notes file, the measurement, a test or a check; cost ~1 Haiku turn/day, ~$0.03/day).

4. Errors and fixes:
   - Tool loading: most requested tools did not load (`add_duty`, `list_duties`, `set_collector`, `try_collector`, `hand_to_coordinator`, `read_guide`, `predict_fix`, `commit_prediction`). Workaround: used the design-layer tools that did load (`declare_stock`, `propose_measurements`, `add_instrument`, `keep_instrument`, `declare_machine`, `declare_expected_effect`, `refine_machine`, `read_design`). Told the owner plainly that the duty could not be written.
   - `read_events` returned 355k characters; fixed by grepping the saved file for event-type counts instead of reading it all.
   - Promising actions after the reply ("I'll start it", "I'll discard it") drew Orchestra corrections; I replied that nothing was started or discarded and waited on the owner.
   - The continuous Notes Improver draft came out at ~$125/day; fixed after the owner asked for a schedule.

5. Problem Solving:
   - Stock and measurement are solved: `notes_files` is declared, measured every 15m, and kept.
   - The daily loop is a Universal Machine instead of a duty, because `add_duty` is unavailable.
   - Overlap: `notes_files_improver` and `notes_improver` are redundant; the owner has not yet said to discard `notes_files_improver`.
   - Open: Notes Files stock is not linked to a discovered stock, so expected effects wait on a `link`; no time zone set for 00:00; `changes.requested`/`gate.rejected` never yet seen published.

6. All user messages:
   - "I want a feedback loop where once per day an agent runs and tries to improve how many notes files get added per day. I think we need to start tracking notes files. Create a Notes Files stock." (sent three times)
   - "Create a new Universal Machine called Notes Improver."
   - "I think the Notes Improver would watch the ticket queue for DONE and REJECTED tickets and the merge gate, figure out why tickets got rejected or failed the gate, and send ideas to the Coordinator to schedule work."
   - "This has a lot of high-throughput event triggers, make it a scheduled task for 12am every day."
   - "Confirm it. I expect notes files to rise, and the commit rate to go up 1.2 times." (followed by the text-only summary instruction)

7. Pending Tasks:
   - Confirm Notes Improver (the owner's "Confirm it"), via `confirm` quoting their words.
   - Declare the owner's expected effect for `notes_improver`: `notes_files` rises, and the commit rate flow × 1.2 (find the commit-rate flow id with `read_design`/`read_model`; horizon not stated, 7d used previously).
   - Discard `notes_files_improver` once the owner says so.
   - Ask for the owner's time zone for the 00:00 schedule.
   - Retry `add_duty` if it ever becomes available.
   - Link the declared `notes_files` stock to a discovered one if the owner says they are the same.

8. Current Work:
   The last assistant action was refining `notes_improver` to scheduled 00:00 (c9.0–c9.5) and offering to discard `notes_files_improver`. The owner has now said "Confirm it. I expect notes files to rise, and the commit rate to go up 1.2 times." No tool was called in response because this turn is a summary-only turn. Confirm has not been executed, and nothing is running.

9. Optional Next Step:
   On the next turn, act on the owner's "Confirm it. I expect notes files to rise, and the commit rate to go up 1.2 times.": load `mcp__orchestra__confirm`, check the design for the commit-rate flow id, call `declare_expected_effect` for `notes_improver` (`rises` on `notes_files`, `factor` 1.2 on the commit-rate flow, quoting their words), then `confirm` `notes_improver` quoting "Confirm it." Then tell the owner what ran, the machine's first run time (next 00:00), and that it is only confirmed when the tool answers. State that "it" was read as Notes Improver, and ask about discarding `notes_files_improver` and about the time zone.
